summary: Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, announcing the launch of a private offering of $600 million in aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2031. The company intends to use net proceeds to fund cash consideration for its previously announced acquisition of Kiavi, Inc., but the offering is not conditioned on that deal's completion. If the acquisition falls through, proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The notes are unregistered, offered under Rule 144A/Reg S exemptions. This filing is a routine capital markets update, not a special-situation event; the relevant special situation is the earlier Kiavi acquisition announcement.
